question: \(a=4i+j-2k\), where \(i,j,k\) are pairwise perpendicular unit vectors. What is \(a\cdot i\)?
solution: With an orthonormal basis, \(a\cdot i\) is the coefficient in the \(i\) direction, which is 4.
